title: Hearty Filipino Chicken Stew
description: A traditional Filipino dish made with chicken, vegetables, and unsweetened coconut milk, cooked in a salt-block vessel to perfection, this recipe is diabetic-friendly and features earthy flavors.
instructions: Preheat the salt-block vessel over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add the chopped onions to the preheated vessel and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and sliced ginger to the vessel and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken thighs to the vessel and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the unsweetened coconut milk, fish sauce, salt, and black pepper to the vessel, stirring to combine.
Add the cubed potatoes and sliced carrots to the vessel, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
